about: Every spoken line in the Elearnea app (single source of truth). Code speaks text; voice/voice.js normalizes it to a key, finds the line id in voice/index.json (generated from this file) and plays the line's files in order. Build: tools/voice/build-manifest.js. Render: tools/voice/regen.py. Mothabet clips: tools/voice/import-mothabet.js. Coverage check: tools/voice/check.js.
normalize: lowercase; curly apostrophes -> '; every character other than a-z 0-9 ' and space -> space; collapse spaces; trim
render: `render` is the text a TTS engine should read. Inline IPA uses [[ ... ]] (Piper syntax), only on phoneme lines, which come from the Mothabet batch.

voice.label: kokoro af_bella
voice.speedNote: standard speed 0.76 for all lines (Hexan 2026-10-29; was 0.88)

credits: Voice: Kokoro-82M by hexgrad (Apache-2.0), voice af_bella.
clipFormat: each file ships as .mp3 and .opus (same name); voice.js plays .opus where the browser supports Ogg Opus, else .mp3

extraSets.mothabet-bella-phonemes: ph_* from the original Mothabet Bella batch (pure sounds; not speed-dependent; unverified)

mothabetMapping.rule: each Mothabet line = sequence of script clips, e.g. "sun. The sun is hot. sun." = w_sun + s_sun + w_sun; "Find the first sound in the word... sun... sun." = p_first_w_sun (one Elearnea-rendered clip, wording approved by Hexan 2026-10-29); "Find the last sound in... sun." = p_last + w_sun; "Try this one. sss." = p_try + ph_s
